impeccable-body.purpose: All interface text inside .impeccable-workspace; never applied globally.

impeccable-mono.purpose: Dollar amounts, percentages, IDs, reference values, table dates only.

shadows.name: impeccable-flat
shadows.purpose: Default state for every static surface (cards, rows, inputs, buttons).

shadows.name: impeccable-floating-hairline
shadows.purpose: Reserved for floating layers only: dialogs, dropdowns, tooltips, popovers, toasts.

motion.name: impeccable-ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover/focus/menu/dialog/tooltip transitions, 100-150ms only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled monochrome primary action button; near-white fill, near-black text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #f2f2f0; color: #0a0a0b; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'Geist Sans', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e0e0dd; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f2f2f0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined ghost button for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #f2f2f0; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'Geist Sans', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #1c1c1f; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f2f2f0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input with hairline border, no glow on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #101012; color: #f2f2f0; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 10px; font-family: 'Geist Sans', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5c5c61; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #f2f2f0; }

components.name: Selected Nav Item
components.description: Active sidebar navigation item: near-white text, subtle wash, left accent bar.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; border-left: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0; font-family: 'Geist Sans', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #9a9a9f; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #f2f2f0; background: #1c1c1f; } .ds-nav-item--active { color: #f2f2f0; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-left-color: #f2f2f0; }

components.name: Monetary Value
components.description: Scannable profit/loss figure: Geist Mono, tabular numerals, semantic color plus explicit sign.
components.css: .ds-money { font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; } .ds-money--positive { color: #46a758; } .ds-money--negative { color: #e5484d; }

narrative.northStar: One product, three coats of paint
narrative.overview: Profit Tracker is a dense financial productivity tool whose visual system is a runtime switcher between three styles selected under Settings -> Appearance and persisted client-side. All three read from the same routed pages and component tree; the difference is almost entirely CSS custom-property values plus, in a handful of files, an explicit uiStyle branch. Neon Dark and Glassmorphism Brown are incumbent and unchanged. Impeccable is the approved, not-yet-implemented third style: flat, monochrome, dark, inspired primarily by shadcn/ui and secondarily by Linear and Vercel.
keyCharacteristics: Three selectable, mutually exclusive UI styles switched by a single data-ui-style attribute on <html>.
Neon Dark's five accent color themes (data-theme) apply only to Neon Dark.
Impeccable is monochrome-only: near-black backgrounds, near-white foreground, color reserved for profit/loss/warning/informational semantics.
No IA change across styles: same routes, same components, same data.

rules.name: The Isolated Palette Rule
rules.body: Impeccable never reads the Copper/Arctic/Jade/Dusk/Signal accent tokens; its root block is placed after the data-theme blocks so it always wins the cascade.

rules.name: The Selective Mono Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is for scannable numeric/technical values only - dollar amounts, percentages, IDs, reference numbers. The interface is never fully monospace.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: If it isn't floating above the page (dialog, dropdown, tooltip, popover, toast), it has no shadow. No exceptions.

rules.name: The No-Inheritance Rule
rules.body: Impeccable must not inherit .carbon-workspace's override rules; it gets its own independent .impeccable-workspace block.

rules.name: The CSS-First Rule
rules.body: Exhaust token/CSS overrides before adding any uiStyle === 'impeccable' JSX branch.

dos: Do reuse the existing data-ui-style/data-theme attribute + CSS custom property mechanism for every Impeccable value.
Do place :root[data-ui-style="impeccable"] after the data-theme blocks in index.css.
Do give Impeccable its own .impeccable-workspace override block, independent from .carbon-workspace.
Do exhaust token/CSS overrides before adding any uiStyle === 'impeccable' JSX branch.
Do reserve color for profit, loss/destructive/error, warning, and rare informational states only.
Do use Geist Mono selectively for scannable numeric/technical values.
Do keep shadows to the floating-layer hairline only.
donts: Don't modify any Neon Dark token, class, or component branch.
Don't modify any Glassmorphism Brown token, class, or component branch.
Don't let the Copper/Arctic/Jade/Dusk/Signal accent picker affect or appear for Impeccable.
Don't add card shadows, hover lift, glow, gradients, backdrop-blur, or decorative blobs inside .impeccable-workspace.
Don't use a filled/saturated color for anything that isn't a profit/loss/warning/informational signal.
Don't apply Geist Mono to the whole interface.
Don't introduce a light-mode variant of Impeccable.
Don't restructure routes, remove features, or change dashboard functionality while implementing this theme.
